The nearest mast is actually 0.5 km west (operator unknown per nearest_site), not 1.4 km; the 1.4 km figure is only for the nearest confirmed Vodafone site. The low speed could stem from capacity, backhaul, or the unknown operator site at 0.5 km. Need trend data to confirm the pattern is persistent and not a one-quarter anomaly.
